title: ENHYPEN to drop final ‘THE SIN’ installment on Nov. 20
summary: K-pop boy group ENHYPEN is set to release a new single album, 'THE SIN : PARALLEL WORLD,' on November 20, marking the final installment in its 'THE SIN' album series.
